title: adidas: Extra 40% off Outlet Items @ adidas Outlet
body:
Deal: adidas: Extra 40% off Outlet Items @ adidas Outlet

[Fernet] I found where all the 28c cancelled socks went.
[superforever] TCB 25% CB apply?
https://www.adidas.com.au/ultimashow-shoes/FX3624.html $28.80 + TCB Cashback.
[NateRiver] Just ordered and TCB cashback tracked. So yes :)
[Kanjus] Yes.$30 cap so max $120 basket which is $200 worth of sale products and you effectively pay $90.
[probablyjarrod] copped some stadts, a running shirt for a friend, and a running jacket for winter!! :)
[Rojohe] Just a heads up when it comes to cashback and Adidas, avoid having multiple items in one order because if they cancel an item then the whole order is disqualified from cashback.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/931825
[amsaini15] Are they comfortable for walking (arent they too flat?)
Just thinking of what to get for my teenage son to uni
[lufee] Anyone know if using Amex card with Adidas credit offer saved (like you cannot undo this), cashback is not ineligible to be true??
[k318830] Shopback is giving 20% cashback plus bonus 10% if you use your linked Westpac card.
[davidsilvata] Will this be available at the outlet store too?
[jizmo] <I understand and agree that in certain circumstances, my personal information may be transferred to other entities in the adidas Group and service providers that are located in countries that do not have comparable privacy safeguards to Australia.
Are they saying they're about as secure as Optus with a 99% chance your data's going to be leaked onto the darkweb, but in a roundabout kind of way?
[Brightland] Thanks! Bought my kid some Spiderman shoes that should come down to just over $30 once I get the cash back. Even $40 is a bargain…
Thanks for the tip on doing separate transactions - this sale last year was a shitshow, I thought I got so many good bargains, only for the entire order to be cancelled a week later. See if I have more luck doing each item individually.
